updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Content Preview in Alerts
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now allows authorized users to preview file content directly within IRM alerts without creating a case, streamlining investigation workflows. This reduces friction when reviewing potentially sensitive activity and helps security teams respond faster to insider risk signals.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Adaptive Scopes for SharePoint
updates.summary: DLP now supports dynamic adaptive scoping for SharePoint, automatically targeting policies based on site attributes like URL, name, and custom metadata instead of requiring manual site lists. This eliminates the 100-site static limit and enables scalable, self-maintaining policy deployment across evolving SharePoint environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Faster Policy Sync (2 hours to 30 minutes)
updates.summary: DLP policy updates now synchronize across the organization in 30 minutes instead of up to 2 hours, ensuring protections take effect more quickly. This reduction in sync latency strengthens real-time data protection and compliance enforcement.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Archive SharePoint Files Under Retention
updates.summary: Administrators can now configure archiving actions within retention policies for SharePoint Online, moving inactive content to low-cost storage while keeping it discoverable. This extends Data Lifecycle Management capabilities beyond keep/delete to include a cost-effective third option aligned with compliance requirements.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Policy Tips Support in Outlook for Mac
updates.summary: DLP policy tips now appear in Outlook for Mac, alerting users in real time when email contains policy-violating sensitive information with options to remove recipients or override policies. This extends compliance notifications to Mac users, closing a platform gap in data loss prevention.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Policy Tips Support in Outlook Mobile
updates.summary: DLP policy tips are now available on Outlook Mobile, delivering real-time alerts to help users avoid sharing sensitive data on mobile devices. This extends data loss prevention enforcement to mobile endpoints, a critical gap for organizations with remote workforces.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – DLP for Copilot Web Search
updates.summary: DLP policies now prevent sensitive data from being used in external web searches by Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat, addressing data leakage risks in AI-assisted workflows. This real-time control ensures that Copilot interactions respect organizational data protection boundaries.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – Analyze Files from Endpoint DLP Alerts
updates.summary: Data Security Investigations can now be launched directly from endpoint DLP alerts, automatically gathering related files that triggered alerts for streamlined review and analysis. This integration accelerates investigation of potential exfiltration incidents by reducing manual data collection steps.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Retention for Copilot Memory
updates.summary: Administrators can now configure retention policies for Microsoft 365 Copilot memory items stored in Exchange mailboxes, enabling oversight of memory versions for compliance and investigation. This capability extends data governance controls to AI-generated contextual data.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Hard Delete for OneDrive and SharePoint
updates.summary: Administrators will gain the ability to perform hard deletions in OneDrive and SharePoint through secure priority cleanup workflows, bypassing the 93-day recycle bin retention period for strict compliance scenarios. This capability addresses regulatory requirements while maintaining safeguards against accidental data loss.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Compliance Manager – AI Foundry Integration
updates.summary: Compliance Manager will integrate with Microsoft AI Foundry to automatically map Agents created in Foundry to compliance regulations and assessments, surfacing compliance status and improvement actions. This integration extends compliance governance into AI agent development workflows.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Compliance Manager – AI-Powered Regulatory Templates
updates.summary: Compliance Manager will use AI to convert complex regulatory PDFs into actionable controls and actions in multi-cloud environments, allowing administrators to quickly build assessments and identify compliance gaps. This automation reduces manual effort in translating regulations into technical controls.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Data Loss Prevention policies can now be applied to sensitive data at rest in non-Microsoft applications such as Box and Google Workspace using existing Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and the same classification engine. This extends DLP protection beyond Microsoft 365 to multi-cloud environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels – Auto-Labeling Simulation Mode
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies can now run in simulation mode to preview which items would be labeled without applying changes, letting administrators review match results and source distribution before enforcement. This safe testing capability reduces risk of misconfigured auto-labeling policies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels – Policy Performance Insights
updates.summary: The Insights tab in auto-labeling policy details now provides at-a-glance visibility into policy performance in simulation or enforcement mode, helping administrators understand labeling effectiveness. This observability improvement aids in tuning and validating labeling policies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels – Auto-Labeling for Non-Microsoft Apps
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies can now protect sensitive data at rest in non-Microsoft connected applications like Box and Google Workspace using Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors. This extends Purview's labeling and classification capabilities across hybrid cloud environments.
